title: RWE AG Company Profile - GlobalData
content: # RWE AG - Company Profile. All the sales intelligence you need on RWE AG in one solution. * Understand how RWE AG fits into your total. when and how to engage with RWE AG. * Top 10 Wind Power Plant Operators in the World in 2021 by Capacity. * Top 10 Biopower Producers in the World by Capacity. * Top 10 Solar Photovoltaics Plant Operators in the World in 2021 by Capacity. RWE AG (RWE) is an energy utility company. The company has presence across the energy value chain, from lignite production and electricity generation to energy trading and operation of distribution networks, and supply of electricity, gas, and energy solutions. RWE trades electricity, oil, natural gas, biomass, coal, and CO2 certificates; retails electricity and gas; and sources fuel needed to produce electricity and heat, and markets the electricity generated by its plants. The company also plans, builds, and operates renewable energy facilities; and manages electricity and gas distribution networks.
